name: IGNITE
summary: IGNITE is the association's long-running student-development and career-guidance programme. Alumni come back to the Vidyalaya to talk honestly about the paths open after school — engineering, medicine, the sciences, government service, entrepreneurship and more.
body:
## IGNITE – Career Counselling and Personality Development

**IGNITE** is one of J**NVCKM's flagship alumni-led initiatives,** focused on career counselling and personality development for students in Classes 10, 11 and 12.

The programme brings alumni and other resource persons together to guide students in understanding career pathways, developing essential skills and preparing for life beyond school.

Highlights reported in the presentation:

- 18 editions completed at the time of the presentation.
- A typical One-day workshop.
- Participation by more than 20 to 25 alumni each year.
- Exposure to professional experiences, career options and personal development.

IGNITE exemplifies the power of alumni mentorship: helping students make informed decisions by learning from those who have travelled similar paths before them.
startNote: Running since the mid-2000s. The tenth edition was held in 2014, the thirteenth in 2017.
